task.question: Who entered negotiations with the Trump administration on March 13, 2026?
task.evidence: March 13 - First Secretary of the Communist Party of Cuba Miguel Díaz-Canel entered negotiations with the Trump administration in an effort to end the United States embargo against Cuba.

answer:
On March 13, 2026, the Trump administration entered negotiations with Cuba. This was confirmed following a period of heightened tensions and a fuel blockade imposed by the administration, which had led to an energy crisis on the island. Cuban President Miguel Díaz-Canel was involved in these discussions. 

FINAL: Cuba
